description: Public month-length regression and correction cases.

cases.title: Leapfrog nepali-date-picker 2082/2083 public month-length regression cluster
cases.authority_boundary: public issue regression case; not official calendar authority
cases.safe_claim: Project Parva tracks Leapfrog issue #70 as a public month-length regression cluster.
forbidden_claims: Do not claim Leapfrog is globally broken.
Do not treat every issue-reported row as official authority.
cases.notes: Exact rows are already preserved in the existing Leapfrog public regression fixture; mixed rows remain review-needed where issue text and Parva's current table differ.

cases.title: Medic bikram-sambat 2081/2082 month-length correction report

reported_expected.source_issue_correction_rows: public issue lists incorrect and correct day counts for each row

cases.authority_boundary: public correction report; exact rows require manual verification before executable use
cases.safe_claim: This issue is tracked as a month-length correction review target.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent correction rows.
Do not claim official authority from the issue alone.
cases.notes: Exact correction rows are represented from the public issue body. Eight rows are split into executable historical regression fixtures where Parva current data matches the public correction row. The 2082-03 and 2082-04 rows remain review-needed because they currently conflict with Parva source policy and require source adjudication before becoming executable assertions. The upstream issue is closed with PR #27.
